entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
This is completely unacceptable! I bought a jersey from you people and it's the absolute wrong size. I want to return it right now!
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear about the issue with the sizing. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF88602. And don't give me the runaround. This jersey is way too tight, I can barely get it on. I need a straightforward exchange or my money back. I'm not playing games.
I understand completely. One moment while I pull up that order. VF88602... Okay, I see it here. It's for the Apex Aero Jersey, delivered 47 days ago.
Yeah, 47 days, so what? Are you going to tell me I'm out of luck? Because if you are, I'm going straight to your manager and then I'm plastering bad reviews all over the internet about your company.

Not at all, sir. I was just confirming the details. Our standard return policy is 90 days. Since you're well within that window, I can absolutely process this for you. We can either do an exchange for a larger size or a full refund. Which would you prefer?
Oh. Well... fine. Just give me the refund. I'll buy something else later. I don't want to risk getting another jersey that's too tight.

No problem. I have initiated the return for a full refund. I am emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off at any post office. You should see the email within the next 5 minutes.
Okay. That's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
